source_signature.notes: Batch 4G skill 5/5, batch closer. Scope Operator-derived. The third member of the N/V/M trio and the axial parallel to shear_force_internal_loading: shear owns V (transverse, SigmaFy), bending_moment owns M (SigmaM about the cut), this owns N - the internal normal/axial force at a cut, from SigmaFx = 0 on the isolated portion, tension-positive / compression-negative. Same parent internal_loading_at_section, same cut-and-equilibrate method, different equation (axial) and sign convention. V and M are the siblings (cited, not solved); axial stress (N/A) and deformation out of scope. Worked example Operator-re-derived (and re-verified after a first-pass review error): inclined F=50 kN at 36.9 deg below +x on a horizontal member, so the 3-4-5 components are Fx = F cos 36.9 = 40 kN (AXIAL, along the member) and Fy = F sin 36.9 = 30 kN (transverse). Overall axial equilibrium gives Ax = -40 kN. Cut at x=1 m (before the load at 2 m); left portion carries Ax to the cut; SigmaFx = 0: Ax - N = 0 -> N = -40 kN = 40 kN COMPRESSION under the tension-positive convention. N is genuinely nonzero because the example carries a real axial load - a transverse-only beam gives N=0 vacuously; the inclined-load resolution makes N real and signed. THREE-signal mapping: axis_confusion at step 3 (the resolution step - assigning the wrong resolved component as axial, e.g. feeding Fy into SigmaFx, or swapping which component is parallel to the member), sign_or_placement_error at step 6 (the tension/compression sign under the convention and the axial-inclusion of Ax), unclassified at step 8 (report/convention boundary). axis_confusion is GENUINELY EARNED and this is the FIRST internal-forces skill to earn it - shear, bending-moment, and the relations/diagram skills had transverse-only or pre-resolved loads with no resolution step, so it was correctly omitted there four times; the inclined load here CREATES a resolution step and the axis-assignment error becomes real. Signal placed by error model, not reflex. solution_sequencing_error OMITTED: single-cut axial solve with given axial reaction, no out-of-order-strands-prerequisite step. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). NOTE the axial component is F cos(36.9)=40 (cos of the smaller angle), not 30 - the resolution is unambiguous from the stated 36.9-deg geometry. CLOSES Batch 4G: skills 45-49 = bending_moment_internal_loading, shear_moment_load_relationships, shear_moment_diagram_construction, maximum_moment_from_zero_shear, normal_force_internal_loading.
